about: Retexture (change) test cases. Each view is rendered from a downloaded scan under data/ (git-ignored), so this file holds no pictures. `find` is the finder command that makes the case's found.json; then `python -m edit_agent.change one --input found.json` edits that view and `pans` edits every panorama that sees the thing. Results go to data/edit_agent/change/runs/<time>-<name>/.

cases.name: pillows-recolor
cases.request: change the blue pillows to red
cases.find: look --scan zzvymDx5ty7 --pano 1 --yaw 213.1 --pitch -16.5 --request "change the blue pillows to red"
cases.want: Every teal-green part of the patterned pillows turns red; their grey pattern and piping stay grey; the plain cream sofa, the painting and the wall do not change. The user says blue, the photo's pillows are teal-green: the colour rule must find the pillows' own hue.
cases.panoramas: 1 (sofa, the found view), 4 and 7 also see the pillows (qwen_test sofa_pillows).
cases.notes: Plural: `look` returns all four patterned pillows in one view, as one mask. Some are mostly grey; their grey stays.

cases.name: countertop-wood
cases.request: change this countertop from granite to wood
cases.find: point --scan zzvymDx5ty7 --pano 4 --yaw 37.6 --pitch -11.8 --at 625,612 --request "change this countertop from granite to wood"
cases.want: The island's white speckled granite becomes wood, with the same edges; the sink, the faucet and the two woven balls on it stay as they are; the cabinets and the floor do not change.
cases.panoramas: 4 (the found view), 1 and 0 also see the island (qwen_test island_decor).
cases.notes: SAM's outline of the countertop already leaves out the sink basins and the balls. Whether the image model keeps them without that help is a question for a view where the outline holds them.

cases.name: lamp-modern
cases.find: point --scan zzvymDx5ty7 --pano 1 --yaw 172.2 --pitch -11.9 --at 517,380 --request "make this lamp more modern"
cases.want: A more modern table lamp of about the same size on the same gold side table, still lit; the glow on the wall stays the photo's own; the side table, the wall and the baseboard do not change. A new outline that overlaps the old one by less than 0.8 is flagged form_changed.
cases.notes: The lit lamp is the case closest to a lighting change. If the image model changes the glow on the wall, the check reports it (shadow_left or light_left) and the photo's glow is kept.
